grammar_title: 强调结构(It is/was … that/who … 强调句:强调主语、宾语、状语,与普通句及定语从句对比)
source: 上外版选择性必修三 Unit 4 Grammar in Use: Emphatic structures(It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who…)。句子地道、环境主题、答案唯一(强调句连接词固定,排除关系副词/which等)。

points.point: 强调句连接词:强调人用 who,强调物/事用 that
points.overview: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who…。被强调的是人(指人的成分)时连接词用 who;被强调的是物或事情时一律用 that,不能用 which。

points.point: 强调状语(时间/地点/原因/方式):连接词仍用 that
points.overview: 强调句强调时间、地点、原因、方式等状语时,连接词都用 that,而不用普通定语从句里的 when/where/why——这正是强调句与定语从句的区别。

points.point: It was not until … that … 与强调一般疑问句/强调主语
points.overview: It was not until + 时间/事件 + that + 主句(直到……才……);一般疑问句强调用 Is/Was it + 被强调部分 + that/who…;强调作主语的人仍用 who。

questions.stem: It was Dr Lin ____ first warned the village about the rising sea.
questions.explanation: 强调句强调的是人 Dr Lin,且在从句中作主语,连接词用 who。

questions.stem: It is the volunteers ____ clean the beach every single weekend.
questions.explanation: 被强调部分 the volunteers 指人,强调句连接词用 who。

questions.stem: It was Janine ____ decided to save the rainforest in Costa Rica.
questions.explanation: 强调的是人 Janine,用 who 引导强调句。

questions.stem: It is ordinary people ____ can make the biggest difference to the planet.
questions.explanation: 被强调部分 ordinary people 指人,连接词用 who。

questions.stem: It was my grandmother ____ taught me to sort the rubbish at home.
questions.explanation: 强调的是人 my grandmother,强调句用 who。

questions.stem: It is scientists ____ have measured the carbon dioxide for many years.
questions.explanation: 被强调部分 scientists 指人,连接词用 who。

questions.stem: It was a young environmentalist ____ started the whole clean-up project.
questions.explanation: 强调的是人,且作从句主语,用 who。

questions.stem: It is the students ____ planted those young trees along the river.
questions.explanation: 被强调部分 the students 指人,强调句用 who。

questions.stem: It was Tom and Lily ____ organised the recycling drive at our school.
questions.explanation: 强调的是人 Tom and Lily,连接词用 who。

questions.stem: It is all of us ____ should take care of the Earth, not just the government.
questions.explanation: 被强调部分 all of us 指人,用 who 引导强调句。

questions.stem: It was carbon dioxide ____ the plants needed in order to produce food.
questions.explanation: 被强调部分 carbon dioxide 指物,强调句一律用 that,不用 which。

questions.stem: It is the greenhouse effect ____ keeps the Earth warm enough for life.
questions.explanation: 强调的是事物 the greenhouse effect,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It was the melting of the ice caps ____ worried the scientists most.
questions.explanation: 被强调部分指事情,强调句用 that,不用 which。

questions.stem: It is plastic waste ____ causes the most harm to sea animals.
questions.explanation: 强调的是物 plastic waste,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It was the burning of fossil fuels ____ released so much carbon dioxide.
questions.explanation: 被强调部分指事情,强调句一律用 that。

questions.stem: It is clean energy ____ many countries are turning to these days.
questions.explanation: 强调的是物 clean energy,连接词用 that,不用 which。

questions.stem: It was a small habit ____ changed the way our whole family lives.
questions.explanation: 被强调部分 a small habit 指物,强调句用 that。

questions.stem: It is the ocean ____ produces about half of the oxygen we breathe.
questions.explanation: 强调的是事物 the ocean,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It was the rising temperature ____ made the glaciers slowly retreat.
questions.explanation: 被强调部分指事物,强调句一律用 that,不用 which。

questions.stem: It is the rubbish left on the beaches ____ finally flows into the sea.
questions.explanation: 强调的是物 the rubbish,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It was in 1958 ____ the carbon dioxide in the air was first measured carefully.
questions.explanation: 强调句强调时间状语 in 1958,连接词用 that,不用 when。

questions.stem: It is in the polar regions ____ the effects of warming show up first.
questions.explanation: 强调地点状语 in the polar regions,强调句用 that,不用 where。

questions.stem: It was because of human activity ____ too much carbon dioxide built up.
questions.explanation: 强调原因状语 because of human activity,连接词用 that,不用 why。

questions.stem: It is on the beaches ____ most of the plastic rubbish finally ends up.
questions.explanation: 强调地点状语 on the beaches,强调句用 that。

questions.stem: It was step by step ____ the family slowly reduced its carbon footprint.
questions.explanation: 强调方式状语 step by step,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It is at night ____ the Earth loses heat by radiating it into space.
questions.explanation: 强调时间状语 at night,强调句用 that,不用 when。

questions.stem: It was in Costa Rica ____ the young environmentalist saved a rainforest.
questions.explanation: 强调地点状语 in Costa Rica,连接词用 that,不用 where。

questions.stem: It is only with everyone's help ____ we can really slow global warming.
questions.explanation: 强调方式/条件状语,强调句用 that。

questions.stem: It was during the last century ____ the forests began to disappear quickly.
questions.explanation: 强调时间状语 during the last century,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It is in the huge Antarctic ice cap ____ most of the world's ice is found.
questions.explanation: 强调地点状语,强调句用 that,不用 where。

questions.stem: It was for this reason ____ the school decided to start a recycling project.
questions.explanation: 强调原因状语 for this reason,连接词用 that,不用 why。

questions.stem: It is by saving energy at home ____ each of us can help the planet.
questions.explanation: 强调方式状语 by saving energy,强调句用 that。

questions.stem: It was after the survey ____ people realised how serious the problem was.
questions.explanation: 强调时间状语 after the survey,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It is near the equator ____ many dry areas now suffer long droughts.
questions.explanation: 强调地点状语 near the equator,强调句用 that,不用 where。

questions.stem: It was little by little ____ the sea level began to rise along the coast.
questions.explanation: 强调方式状语 little by little,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It is every weekend ____ the volunteers gather to clean up the river.
questions.explanation: 强调时间状语 every weekend,强调句用 that,不用 when。

questions.stem: It was through cutting down forests ____ humans made the problem worse.
questions.explanation: 强调方式状语,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It is in the oceans ____ a huge quantity of waste ends up each year.
questions.explanation: 强调地点状语 in the oceans,强调句用 that,不用 where。

questions.stem: It was not long ago ____ people first heard the words 'carbon footprint'.
questions.explanation: 强调时间状语 not long ago,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It is for the sake of our children ____ we must protect the Earth now.
questions.explanation: 强调原因/目的状语,强调句用 that,不用 why。

questions.stem: It was not until midnight ____ the rescue team reached the flooded village.
questions.explanation: It was not until … that … 是固定的强调结构,空格用 that。

questions.stem: It was not until the ice began to melt ____ people saw the real danger.
questions.explanation: not until 强调结构,主句前用 that。

questions.stem: It was not until 2020 ____ the city finally banned thin plastic bags.
questions.explanation: It was not until + 时间 + that…,空格用 that。

questions.stem: It is not until rubbish is picked up ____ the beach becomes safe again.
questions.explanation: not until 强调结构,连接用 that。

questions.stem: It was not until the forests disappeared ____ less carbon dioxide was removed.
questions.explanation: It was not until … that … 强调,空格用 that。

questions.stem: It was not until the survey came out ____ we understood the whole problem.
questions.explanation: not until 强调结构,用 that 连接主句。

questions.stem: It is not until we act together ____ global warming can really be slowed.
questions.explanation: It is not until … that … 强调,空格用 that。

questions.stem: It was not until last year ____ our school started sorting its waste.
questions.explanation: It was not until + 时间 + that…,空格用 that。

questions.stem: Was it the greenhouse effect ____ caused the temperature to rise so fast?
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句强调结构 Was it … that …,强调物用 that。

questions.stem: Is it really plastic ____ does the most harm to the sea turtles?
questions.explanation: 强调句一般疑问形式 Is it … that …,强调物用 that。

questions.stem: Was it carbon dioxide ____ the plants needed to make their own food?
questions.explanation: Was it … that … 强调结构,强调物用 that,不用 which。

questions.stem: Is it clean energy ____ our country is turning to in order to cut emissions?
questions.explanation: 强调句一般疑问形式,强调物用 that。

questions.stem: It was the volunteers ____ first cleaned up that part of the coast.
questions.explanation: 强调作主语的人 the volunteers,连接词用 who。

questions.stem: Is it the young environmentalist ____ leads the rainforest project now?
questions.explanation: 强调句一般疑问形式,强调的是人,用 who。

questions.stem: It was only after the flood ____ the town built much higher sea walls.
questions.explanation: 强调时间状语 only after the flood,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It was by reducing packaging ____ the shop cut its waste in half.
questions.explanation: 强调方式状语 by reducing packaging,强调句用 that。

questions.stem: It is the rising sea ____ threatens many low-lying coastal cities today.
questions.explanation: 强调作主语的事物 the rising sea,连接词用 that,不用 which。

questions.stem: It was the melting glaciers ____ first showed the world the real danger.
questions.explanation: 强调作主语的事物,强调句用 that。

questions.stem: It is everyone's small effort ____ adds up to one big change in the end.
questions.explanation: 强调作主语的事物 everyone's small effort,连接词用 that。

questions.stem: It was not until the air grew dirty ____ the old factory was finally closed.
questions.explanation: It was not until … that … 强调结构,空格用 that。
